name: Survive the Swarm
detailed_description:
Command a specialized squad of solarpunk exterminators in Survive the Swarm, a tactical bullet-hell roguelite set in a vibrant world under siege. Harness elemental abilities, manage squad growth, and build synergistic loadouts in fast-paced 15-minute missions filled with danger, upgrades, and strategy.

Key Features:

12 Unique Exterminators

Choose from a diverse cast of melee and ranged heroes, each with signature weapons and elemental affinities: Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Poison. Discover the playstyle that suits you best and create devastating squad combinations.

Evolving Tactical Combat

Unlock new special abilities and weapons as you fight. Adapt to unpredictable scenarios with every run, using strategy and reflexes to survive escalating swarm attacks.

Procedural Power Growth

Every level-up offers a randomized choice of upgrades, encouraging fresh builds and creative approaches. From crit-boosting ice builds to poison-enhanced damage chains, no two runs are the same.

Permanent Progression

Win or lose, you earn Honor Points that permanently improve your squad’s stats. Increase health, speed, crit chance, elemental damage, and more through meta-upgrades between runs.

Swarm Events and Boss Battles

Face off against swarm waves, intense mini-bosses, and powerful final bosses in a structured 15-minute challenge run. Recruit new exterminators mid-run to adapt your strategy and respond to the growing threat. Use tactics, terrain, and timing to survive.

Strategic Meta Choices

Explore a world where achievements unlock new characters, maps, and difficulty levels. Choose whether to push for more power now or invest in long-term strength.

Stand your ground. Evolve your squad. Survive the swarm.

short_description: Dodge, dash, and destroy bugs with your squad in a fast-paced fight against a relentless insect invasion. Choose from a roster of elite exterminators, each armed with powerful weapons and elemental powers. Evolve your squad mid-run and unlock lasting upgrades to stand against the ever-growing swarm.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low graphics setting
